function_v0.doc: Cross-contract target of the confidential token: verifies an\nUltraHonk proof against the construction-time key.
function_v0.name: verify_proof

function_v0.doc: Writes the six circuit VKs in circuit order:\nRegister, Withdraw, Transfer, SpenderTransfer, SetSpender,\nClawback. Panics unless exactly six keys are supplied.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: Returns the construction-time verification key for a circuit.
function_v0.name: get_verification_key

udt_enum_v0.doc:
Identifier of a zero-knowledge circuit whose verification key is stored in
the registry. The numeric values are part of the on-chain interface and
MUST NOT change. Core token circuits occupy `0..=4`; circuits shipped by
optional extensions start at `100`.
udt_enum_v0.name: CircuitType

cases.doc: Indicates `circuit_type` already has a verification key registered.
cases.name: VerificationKeyAlreadyRegistered

cases.doc: Indicates no verification key is registered under `circuit_type`.
cases.name: VerificationKeyNotRegistered

cases.doc: Indicates the proof failed UltraHonk verification.
cases.name: InvalidProof

cases.doc: Indicates the registered verification key could not be parsed as a valid\nUltraHonk verification key.
cases.name: InvalidVerificationKey

event_v0.doc: Event emitted when a new verification key is registered.
event_v0.name: VerificationKeyRegistered
